# Allync - AI & Digital Solutions

> Allync provides business automation solutions including AI assistants, web development, mobile apps, and digital marketing services.

## Company Overview
Allync is a technology company based in Turkey specializing in AI-powered business automation and digital transformation solutions. We help businesses streamline operations through intelligent automation.

## Services

### AI Solutions
- **WhatsApp AI Assistants**: Intelligent chatbots for customer service automation
- **Custom AI Chatbots**: Tailored conversational AI for specific business needs
- **Voice AI & Cloning**: Advanced voice synthesis and cloning technology
- **Document AI**: Intelligent document processing and analysis
- **Data Analysis AI**: AI-powered business intelligence and analytics

### Digital Solutions
- **Web Development**: Modern, responsive websites and web applications
- **Mobile App Development**: iOS and Android native and cross-platform apps
- **E-commerce Solutions**: Online store development and optimization
- **Digital Marketing**: SEO, social media, and online advertising
- **Cloud Solutions**: Cloud infrastructure and migration services
- **IoT Solutions**: Internet of Things implementation and integration
